issues.description: Page titles and back buttons hidden behind fixed MudAppBar across all pages
issues.fix: Added pt-16 to MudMainContent in MainLayout.razor

issues.description: App bar role/org controls look awkward. User suggested inline hyperlink pattern: 'Casey Hart as System Admin for Internal Operations'
issues.reason: Significant UX redesign — needs its own design session

issues.description: Security Dashboard has duplicate headers (page h4 + component h1)
Dashboard search fields discard input — SearchOrdersAsync and SearchProductsAsync navigate without passing search term
issues.fix: Pass search term as ?search= query param; added InitialSearchTerm parameter to list components with CompositeFilterDescriptor

issues.description: Currency columns left-aligned in Products and Orders grids
issues.fix: Added CellStyle/HeaderStyle text-align:right with max-width:130px; added Bordered=true to all grids

issues.description: Product filter panel reported as not working by UAT reviewer
issues.reason: E2E tests for RoastLevel and price range filters pass. May be specific filters or user state. Needs further investigation.

issues.description: Product detail back button and title partially hidden by app bar
issues.fix: Resolved by UAT-001 (systemic app bar offset fix)

issues.description: Product detail Undo button stays permanently disabled after editing select/numeric/checkbox fields
issues.fix: Replaced @bind-Value with explicit Value+ValueChanged on UnitPrice, RoastLevel, CaffeineContent, GrindType, IsAvailable — all now call OnFieldChanged

issues.description: Date columns left-aligned in Orders grid, don't line up well under headers when columns are wide
issues.fix: Right-aligned with max-width:130px; added Bordered=true for column separation

issues.description: Reports return no data for 2025 date range. MudDatePicker is readonly by default — typed dates not accepted
issues.fix: Added Editable=true, DateFormat, and Placeholder to ParameterPromptForm date pickers

issues.description: User Management inaccessible for sloane.reyes — Admin drawer group hidden because isAdmin only checks current org's roles
issues.fix: isAdmin check in ShellSessionStateLoader now considers BackofficeUserAdmin across all org memberships

issues.description: Filter panel and grid font sizes differ slightly
issues.reason: FilterPanel already uses Margin.Dense. Remaining delta is MudBlazor default — acceptable per reviewer.

issues.description: Security Dashboard tabs (Page Access, Entity Access, Endpoint Access, Control Permissions, Row Filters, User Assignments) show 'No items registered'
issues.reason: Web app has not wired RegisterPages/RegisterEntities/RegisterEndpoints calls. Tracked as separate session set: security-dashboard-wiring.

issues.description: Report columns use only ~6" of 9.5" landscape page width
issues.fix: Spread column positions to full 9.5" width in both orders-by-customer.rdf.json and sales-by-product.rdf.json

issues.reason: No specific feedback provided beyond general observation. Monitor in future UAT.
